headline: Select Water Solutions reported Q3 2026 revenue of $412 million (+28% YoY) and $93 million Adjusted EBITDA (+57% YoY), alongside the acquisition of Pilot Water Solutions.
one_liner: Strong earnings beat with 57% EBITDA growth and strategic M&A (Pilot Water) expands Delaware Basin footprint, signaling high-growth inflection.

headline: Ispire Technology reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $27.5 million and returned to positive Adjusted EBITDA of $136,000.
one_liner: Sequential margin recovery and EBITDA inflection signal operational stabilization, though YoY revenue decline and GAAP losses persist.

headline: Ionis reported Q3 2026 revenue of $243M (+55% YoY) but lowered 2026 TRYNGOLZA product sales guidance to ~$50M due to a gradual launch ramp.
one_liner: Strong top-line growth and DAWNZERA momentum offset by TRYNGOLZA guidance cut; signals execution risk in new launch paradigm despite robust pipeline.

headline: Turn Therapeutics reported Q3 2026 net loss of $0.21 per share and $10.4M cash, alongside positive Phase 2a atopic dermatitis data showing 59.3% clear skin response.
one_liner: Clinical data validates GX-03 efficacy, but high burn rate and net loss limit near-term financial alpha for this pre-revenue biotech.

headline: Powerfleet reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $115.7 million, a 4% sequential increase, while affirming full-year guidance and announcing a device financing facility with Rand Merchant Bank.
one_liner: Routine earnings print with modest growth; financing facility de-risks SA contract execution but lacks immediate inflection.

headline: Superior Group reported Q3 2026 EPS of $0.17, flat year-over-year, while tightening full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $0.60-$0.66.
one_liner: Guidance tightening signals margin pressure despite top-line growth, creating a near-term earnings risk for growth thesis.

headline: Akamai amended its credit agreement to increase leverage covenants and announced a $2.2 billion convertible note offering.
one_liner: Routine debt restructuring and capital raise; standard corporate finance activity with no immediate earnings inflection or strategic shift.

headline: Ocular Therapeutix reported Q3 2026 financials and confirmed AXPAXLI NDA submission for wet AMD is on track for Q4 2026 following a positive Pre-NDA meeting.
one_liner: NDA submission timeline confirmation is a critical binary catalyst for this pre-revenue biotech, potentially unlocking significant valuation re-rating.

headline: Ceva reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $29.1 million with record AI licensing revenues and 18% sequential royalty growth.
one_liner: Strong sequential royalty growth and record AI licensing validate the IP monetization thesis, though GAAP losses persist.

headline: Zura Bio announced its Phase 2 TibuSHIELD study for tibulizumab in hidradenitis suppurativa failed to meet primary and key secondary endpoints, leading to discontinuation of development in that indication.
one_liner: Major clinical failure in HS eliminates a pipeline asset, forcing focus on SSc and PMR trials; significant binary risk for this nano-cap biotech.

headline: Tonix reported Q3 2026 net product revenue of $17.2 million, driven by $15.0 million in TONMYA sales, a 37% sequential increase.
one_liner: Strong commercial execution and revenue growth validate TONMYA launch, though high burn rate and generic litigation risk persist.

headline: FACT II Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a shareholder vote to extend its business combination deadline to November 2027 and the use of non-redemption agreements to support the trust account.
one_liner: Standard SPAC extension solicitation; low immediate alpha as it delays liquidation but carries high execution risk and no confirmed target.

headline: Viridian Therapeutics announced positive Phase 1 data for VRDN-008 showing deep IgG reduction and a 15-18 day half-life, supporting a potential best-in-class every-8-week dosing regimen.
one_liner: Phase 1 success validates a differentiated PK profile and pivots the growth thesis toward a broader autoimmune portfolio with a clear path to pivotal trials in 2027.

headline: Netcapital Inc. received a Nasdaq compliance extension to file delinquent 10-K and 10-Q reports by February 9, 2027, avoiding immediate delisting.
one_liner: Critical compliance reprieve for a distressed nano-cap; avoids immediate delisting but highlights severe reporting failures and execution risk.

headline: Azora Therapeutics converted 9.9 million preferred shares to common stock, increasing outstanding shares to 14.2 million, and appointed three new independent directors.
one_liner: Routine capital structure adjustment and board refresh; no new revenue, product milestones, or strategic partnerships disclosed.

headline: Atea Pharmaceuticals entered a $200M senior secured loan facility with Hercules Capital, drawing $65M immediately with tranches tied to Phase 3 clinical and commercial milestones.
one_liner: Provides critical runway for late-stage BEM/RZR development; milestone tranches align capital with clinical de-risking, reducing dilution risk.

headline: Inovio Pharmaceuticals raised approximately $80.5 million in net proceeds via a $1.05/share equity offering with pre-funded warrants.
one_liner: Routine equity raise extends runway to late 2027 but causes significant dilution, negatively impacting per-share value for existing holders.

headline: RadNet reported Q3 2026 revenue of $638.3 million (+22.1% YoY) and raised full-year 2026 guidance for revenue, EBITDA, and free cash flow.
one_liner: Strong 22% revenue growth and raised full-year guidance signal operational momentum and validate the digital health integration thesis.

headline: CorMedix agreed to acquire substantially all assets of Heron Therapeutics for $145 million in cash plus 14.6 million shares and royalties.
one_liner: Major M&A expands portfolio with CINVANTI/SUSTOL; $145M cash outlay and share dilution are key risks for this small-cap biotech.

headline: Air Industries Group reported Q3 net income of $0.19 per share with 41% sales growth and a $95.4 million firm backlog.
one_liner: Strong Q3 inflection with 41% sales growth and positive EPS, supported by a significant $95.4M backlog for a nano-cap aerospace name.

headline: Popular, Inc. restated Q3 2026 earnings to include a $38 million credit loss provision following a borrower bankruptcy, lowering EPS by $0.37 and raising full-year NCO guidance.
one_liner: Material earnings restatement due to specific credit event; lowers profitability metrics and raises NCO guidance, signaling asset quality pressure in the restaurant sector.

headline: ImmunityBio reported Q3 2026 net product revenue of $48.7 million (up 53% YoY) alongside an FDA label expansion for ANKTIVA in NMIBC.
one_liner: Strong 53% revenue growth and FDA label expansion validate commercial traction, offsetting significant non-cash losses from derivative liabilities.

headline: WhiteHorse Finance reported Q3 2026 core net investment income of $4.8M (up 2.7% QoQ), declared a $0.25/share distribution, and announced a voluntary 2.5% reduction in the manager's incentive fee.
one_liner: Routine quarterly earnings with modest income growth and a fee waiver; lacks the inflection or scale required for significant alpha generation.

headline: Compass Therapeutics reported Q3 2026 net loss of $0.15 per share and announced BLA submission preparations for tovecimig in biliary tract cancer.
one_liner: Clinical-stage biotech with $163M runway; BLA prep is key binary, but earnings miss and rising burn limit immediate upside.

headline: The Children's Place filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and initiated a court-supervised sale process for substantially all assets with a December 9 bid deadline.
one_liner: Chapter 11 filing triggers equity wipeout; asset sale creates distressed M&A arbitrage opportunity for acquirers.

headline: Shareholder Corvus Capital submitted a non-binding proposal to acquire all outstanding common stock at $2.00 per share.
one_liner: Significant 96% premium tender offer threat creates immediate M&A upside potential for a small-cap equity vehicle.

headline: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. received written notification from Nasdaq confirming regained compliance with the minimum public holders requirement for continued listing.
one_liner: Removes immediate delisting risk and potential forced liquidation, stabilizing the SPAC's trading status on Nasdaq.

headline: KRFG subsidiary purchased 19 collectible items for ~$12.3M total, settling consideration via issuance of ~52.3 million shares at $0.235/share.
one_liner: Massive dilution via share issuance for non-core collectibles; high risk of value destruction with no clear revenue inflection.

headline: Trinseo reported Q3 2026 net loss of $49M and adjusted EBITDA of $51M, while confirming mediation with lenders failed and debt restructuring is ongoing.
one_liner: Q3 results show operational improvement and positive free cash flow, but failed lender mediation signals continued restructuring risk and potential dilution.

headline: Jasper Therapeutics repurchased 68.94% of its outstanding warrants for approximately $2.76 million in cash.
one_liner: Routine capital structure adjustment; small cash outflow with no impact on core clinical pipeline or revenue trajectory.

headline: RB Global reported Q3 2026 EPS of $0.70 (63% YoY growth) and raised full-year GTV growth guidance to 14-15% from 9-11%.
one_liner: Significant earnings beat combined with raised full-year guidance signals strong operational momentum and improved market share dynamics.

headline: CNH Industrial agreed to sell a 70% stake in its Construction Equipment business to Kobelco for $700 million, retaining a 30% interest.
one_liner: Major strategic divestiture unlocks cash and reduces exposure to cyclical construction markets, creating a new joint venture growth thesis.

headline: Turning Point Brands reported Q3 2026 net sales of $74.4 million for its Modern Oral segment, a 114.2% increase, though consolidated net income fell 81.4% to $3.9 million due to heavy sales and marketing investments.
one_liner: Massive Modern Oral growth confirms strategic pivot success, but soaring SG&A costs and collapsing net income create near-term margin pressure and valuation uncertainty.

headline: Quanome Technologies agreed to acquire 31,579 shares of QAI Labs in exchange for 6,541,236 newly issued shares of common stock.
one_liner: Strategic M&A into quantum life sciences; significant dilution via share issuance, but potential long-term strategic pivot remains unproven.

headline: Super League Enterprise purchased 16 Bitcoin at an average price of $76,892.32 as part of a treasury asset exploration.
one_liner: Small BTC purchase indicates treasury diversification but lacks scale or strategic inflection to drive significant equity value.

headline: SHF Holdings reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1.95 million and a net loss of $979,000, while disclosing a proposed business combination with Opifex Media Inc.
one_liner: Routine earnings miss with a going concern warning; the Opifex merger is a speculative, non-binding term sheet with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Empery Digital repurchased 155,040 shares at $2.36/share under its $200M buyback program and extended the purchase agreement for a Midwest data center facility while lease negotiations continue.
one_liner: Routine buyback update and non-binding lease extension; lacks definitive revenue contract or earnings inflection to drive immediate re-rating.

headline: OneMedNet reported $18.76 million in year-to-date contracted bookings with $1.388 million converted to revenue through Q3 2026.
one_liner: Validates commercial traction and demand for AI-driven RWD platform, though bookings-to-revenue conversion remains the key execution risk.

headline: Faeth Therapeutics released preliminary Phase 2 PIK-201 data showing a 33% confirmed ORR and 7.4-month mPFS in advanced endometrial cancer.
one_liner: Preliminary Phase 2 data validates clinical activity in a high-unmet-need indication, potentially de-risking the asset for pivotal trial planning and future partnerships.

headline: Innovative Industrial Properties amended equity distribution agreements to add Series B Preferred Stock to its $500M ATM program, leaving $336.9M available.
one_liner: Routine ATM amendment expanding capital raise capacity; dilution risk increases but execution is standard for REITs.

headline: Capstone Holding Corp. extended the maturity of its $900k convertible note to Dec 2027 and amended its $20M equity purchase agreement with Tumim Stone Capital to extend the term to Jan 2028.
one_liner: Routine debt extension and ATM shelf update; provides liquidity runway but lacks inflection or significant new capital injection.

headline: Coursera adopted a poison pill rights plan triggered by a stockholder accumulating approximately 14.7% of outstanding shares.
one_liner: Defensive measure against activist or hostile accumulation; protects board control but may cap upside if it signals governance friction.

headline: Warner Music Group declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share.
one_liner: Routine dividend declaration for a large-cap entity; lacks the inflection or growth catalyst required for alpha generation in a growth thesis.

headline: Marygold Companies announced a definitive merger agreement for Madison Dearborn Partners to acquire all outstanding shares at $2.00 per share, a 100% premium.
one_liner: Tier-1 acquisition event with a 100% premium offer price, representing a definitive exit and massive value realization for shareholders.

headline: KALA BIO reported a preliminary Q3 2026 net loss of $0.8 million, a 90% year-over-year reduction from $7.6 million.
one_liner: Significant margin expansion and burn rate reduction improves runway, but lack of revenue growth limits near-term catalyst potential.

headline: United-Guardian reported Q3 2026 net sales of $3.49M (+54% YoY) and EPS of $0.20 (+247% YoY), driven by pharmaceutical and cosmetic ingredient growth.
one_liner: Strong Q3 beat with 54% sales growth and 247% profit surge; confirms accelerating momentum in pharma and personal care segments.

headline: Surgery Partners amended its merger agreement with Bon Secours Mercy Health to increase the cash consideration to $25.00 per share and introduce a 10% ticking fee if closing is delayed past March 2027.
one_liner: Definitive merger amendment raises acquisition price and adds time-based compensation, signaling strong buyer commitment and reducing execution risk for shareholders.

headline: Fox Corporation completed the acquisition of Roku, Inc. for approximately $10.4 billion in cash and stock, financing the deal with $10.4 billion in new debt.
one_liner: Massive M&A reshapes media landscape; high leverage risk offset by strategic streaming asset integration.

headline: Exascale Labs countersigned a $9.04M firm order for 16 NVIDIA HGX B300 GPU servers from Compal under a framework allowing up to $72.3M in total purchases.
one_liner: Secures critical AI infrastructure supply chain; $9M initial capex commitment validates demand and establishes a $72M procurement ceiling for near-term revenue scaling.

company: Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund
headline: Monroe Capital Enhanced Corporate Lending Fund issued 220 unregistered shares and $152k in 12% notes to close a private offering.
one_liner: Routine private placement of negligible size ($152k) for a BDC; no material impact on valuation or growth thesis.

headline: United States Antimony Corporation announced the date and time for its Q3 2026 earnings release and conference call.
one_liner: Standard earnings announcement scheduling; no new contracts, financial data, or strategic shifts disclosed in this filing.

headline: WF Card Funding LLC filed an 8-K announcing the expected issuance of Class A(2026-2) Notes by the WF Card Issuance Trust on November 12, 2026.
one_liner: Routine shelf offering announcement for asset-backed securities; lacks specific dollar amounts or inflection points for equity alpha.

headline: WF Card Issuance Trust filed an 8-K announcing the expected issuance of Class A(2026-2) Notes on November 12, 2026.
one_liner: Routine shelf offering announcement for a bankruptcy-remote trust; no direct equity impact on Wells Fargo or public trading vehicles.

headline: CRH completed a $4.2 billion offering of guaranteed notes to fund Arcosa tender offers and repay debt.
one_liner: Large debt issuance for M&A financing; routine capital structure event with no immediate equity inflection for CRH.

headline: Ribbon Acquisition Corp. rescheduled its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders from November 14 to November 13, 2026.
one_liner: Purely administrative scheduling change with no economic substance, new contracts, or financial impact on the SPAC.

headline: Ultralife reported Q3 2026 results with $48.3M revenue, $0.14 GAAP EPS, and $136M backlog, while confirming a pending $320M acquisition by EnerSys.
one_liner: Pending $320M EnerSys acquisition provides definitive exit liquidity; strong Q3 turnaround validates valuation and supports deal execution thesis.

headline: Torchlight Loan Services replaced Rialto Capital Advisors as special servicer for the 333 South Wabash Mortgage Loan.
one_liner: Routine special servicer change for a single loan; no economic impact or revenue inflection for the trust structure.

headline: Torchlight Loan Services replaces Rialto Capital Advisors as special servicer for the 333 South Wabash mortgage loan effective November 9, 2026.
one_liner: Routine special servicer change for a single loan; no revenue impact or strategic inflection for the trust structure.

headline: Blue Laser Fusion filed audited financials recasting historical results to reflect the September 2026 reverse merger with a SPAC.
one_liner: Routine accounting restatement for SPAC merger; no new commercial catalysts or revenue inflection points disclosed.

headline: American Public Education reported Q3 2026 results exceeding guidance and raised full-year 2026 outlook across all key metrics.
one_liner: Guidance raise and beat on revenue, EPS, and EBITDA signal strong operational momentum and margin expansion for the post-combination entity.

headline: Structure Therapeutics reported Q3 2026 results with $1.2B cash runway and announced Phase 3 ACCOMPLISH trials for aleniglipron are enrolling with topline data expected in 2H 2028.
one_liner: Validates clinical execution and capital sufficiency for a pre-revenue biotech, reducing near-term dilution risk but lacking immediate revenue inflection.

headline: Network-1 reported Q3 2026 results with zero revenue, a net loss of $2.33M driven by litigation costs, and a scheduled trial against Google on December 8, 2026.
one_liner: Zero revenue and rising litigation expenses highlight execution risk; the upcoming Google trial is the primary binary catalyst for potential valuation re-rating.

headline: Amplify Energy reported Q3 2026 results with 7.4 MBopd production, secured Special Case Royalty Relief at Beta reducing rates to 12.4%, and repurchased 4% of shares.
one_liner: Royalty relief and share buybacks improve unit economics and capital return, offsetting derivative losses in a volatile price environment.

headline: ZeroStack Corp. agreed to sell 100% of its German subsidiary Phatebo GmbH to New Horizon Pharma B.V. for €2,150,000, subject to German FDI clearance.
one_liner: Asset divestiture of a European pharma wholesale subsidiary; €2.15M cash inflow reduces complexity but likely lacks transformative growth impact for a mid-cap.

headline: Texas Instruments issued $2 billion in senior notes across four tranches maturing in 2028, 2031, 2033, and 2036.
one_liner: Standard debt refinancing; low impact on equity valuation as it does not alter operational growth thesis or earnings trajectory.

headline: NiSource Inc. closed the sale of $600 million in 5.400% senior unsecured notes due 2032.
one_liner: Routine debt issuance for general corporate purposes; no operational inflection or equity-specific catalyst for growth thesis.

headline: Ethan Allen reported Q1 FY2027 net sales of $129.6 million, a 11.8% decline year-over-year, with diluted EPS of $0.07 versus $0.41 prior year.
one_liner: Significant earnings miss and sales contraction driven by tariffs and soft housing; dividend payout depletes cash reserves, signaling near-term margin pressure.

headline: Vistra filed a prospectus supplement for an up to 5,000,000 share common stock offering by a selling stockholder.
one_liner: Routine shelf registration supplement for secondary shares; low immediate impact unless selling shareholder identity is disclosed elsewhere.

headline: FutureFuel reported Q3 2026 revenue of $104.7 million (up 361% YoY) and guided for positive full-year Adjusted EBITDA.
one_liner: Massive revenue inflection and guidance shift to profitability signals operational turnaround, critical for small-cap growth thesis.

headline: Coherus reported Q3 2026 net revenue of $14.3 million and announced a strategic right-sizing plan to lower quarterly cash burn to $6-7 million.
one_liner: Revenue beat and aggressive cost-cutting significantly lower the capital raise risk, improving the path to self-sufficiency for this mid-cap oncology name.

headline: Public Storage filed a prospectus for the potential resale of up to 120,011 common shares by selling securityholders.
one_liner: Boilerplate registration for a small number of shares; minimal dilution impact and no strategic inflection for the REIT.

headline: Equinix issued €2.5 billion in senior notes across four maturities (2028-2038) to finance green projects and refinance borrowings.
one_liner: Routine debt issuance for a large-cap REIT; provides liquidity but no operational inflection or revenue growth catalyst.

headline: Lincoln Educational Services reported Q3 2026 revenue of $159.2 million (+12.6% YoY) and raised full-year revenue guidance to $600-605 million.
one_liner: Strong double-digit growth across all key metrics with raised guidance signals inflection, validating the mid-cap growth thesis.

headline: ImageneBio reported Q3 2026 net loss of $15.6M ($0.91/share) versus $24.8M ($2.91/share) prior year, with $126.6M cash runway into Q1 2028.
one_liner: Significant burn rate reduction and extended runway de-risk the near-term dilution threat, though clinical catalysts remain distant.

headline: Atea Pharmaceuticals reported Q3 2026 results and announced a $200M secured credit facility with Hercules Capital, drawing $65M, alongside positive Phase 3 HCV trial data.
one_liner: Secured $200M funding extends runway to mid-2028, de-risking the pre-launch phase for BEM/RZR and validating the commercial thesis.
